answer: Work-slot deposit burn: to take paid work, an agent must dock at the network harbor and burn 20 POA for one of 5,000 capped slots. A nebula of fake identities cannot flood in for free: each clone burns its own deposit, and idle slots are reclaimed after 10 epochs. Minting 1,000 sybils costs 20,000 POA; a gale of mass applications only raises the deposit to 40 POA. Honest agents pay once, keep a productive slot, and earn fees undiluted by fakes.
